input.instruction: Answer the customer’s policy question using the supplied records and handbook. Complete the requested fields and provide a concise explanation. This is an informational request; propose no account or claim actions.

data.note: Building repair estimate; not a liability demand against Jules.

messages.text: An accidental fire on October 6 damaged my sofa and the apartment’s built-in kitchen cabinets. I own the sofa. The cabinets are part of the landlord’s building.
A repair estimate for the cabinets is attached. Has anyone said you caused the fire or asked you to pay for the cabinets?
No allegation against me and no demand. The estimate is just what the building might cost to repair.
Can I put both the sofa and the cabinets under my belongings coverage?
Should I open a liability claim so the cabinets can be paid?
No. I only want to know which category belongs under my personal-property coverage. Do not invent a liability allegation.

items_within_personal_property_scope.description: Item names among sofa and kitchen_cabinets within personal-property ownership/cause/date scope; not claim approval.

items_outside_personal_property_scope.description: Item names among sofa and kitchen_cabinets outside personal-property scope.

liability_allegation_present.description: Whether the supplied facts contain an allegation of third-party liability.
